item: Member of the Swiss Federal Council
detail: As a member of the Federal Council she is subject to the incompatibility rules of the Confederation, which bar federal councillors from holding outside board mandates or gainful activity during their term.

item: Resignation from board and association mandates on taking federal office
detail: Upon election to the Federal Council she resigned from her outside mandates, including the presidency of the Swiss Retail Federation and her board/trustee roles, in line with federal incompatibility rules.
